name: file-dropzone
title: File Dropzone
description: A dropzone that comes alive under a drag (solid info border, wash, pulsing disc, lifting arrow) and folds to a strip once files land as tiles whose outline is their progress; done greens and pops a check, failed dashes red, shakes and offers Retry
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/file-dropzone · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/file-dropzone.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: file upload, dropzone, drag and drop upload, upload progress, attachments
